intent: Correct reproduced Gitleaks generic-api-key false positives for an exact token-estimate schema label and an exact public model-file SHA256 pin, while retaining credential detection for all other values, fields, paths and neighboring material.

original_finding.classification: Exact uppercase schema label describing UTF8-byte token estimation; no credential value or assignment.

scope: Each new generic-api-key exception requires BOTH its exact source path AND the complete literal metadata/pin line. Every other field/value/path, appended same-line content, rule, historical revision and existing ignore fingerprint remains scanned.

preserved_detections: Additional credential-shaped field on the same line
validation.synthetic_controls: Generated only in scratch; no credential material added to repository history.

validation.classification: Two metadata instances plus the public model-file SHA256 pin

additional_classification.proof: The harness computes hashlib.file_digest of the actual model input and compares it to this pin. It is not an authentication credential.
